caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of patterned fabric in monochromatic brown tones. The central area contains a dense composition of large, detailed flowers and leaves intertwined throughout the design. Among the floral motifs, there are two illustrations of small houses with pitched roofs situated in clearing-like spaces, surrounded by trees and shrubbery. Additionally, there are two round portrait medallions, each with a bust of a person, surrounded by leafy garlands. One of the medallions includes a visible inscription. The background consists entirely of a brown color, with the design details rendered in a lighter shade, creating strong contrast and depth. The entire fabric section is bordered by a soft, slightly irregular edge, set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Historical Printed Cotton
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
